stemText: Which eukaryotic cell organelle is the primary site for the packaging, post-translational chemical modification, and sorting of proteins and lipids into glycoproteins and glycolipids?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: Proteins synthesized on the ribosomes of RER enter the cis (forming) face of the Golgi apparatus.
Step 2: Within Golgi cisternae, they undergo glycosylation to form glycoproteins and glycolipids.
Step 3: Modified products are budded off from the trans (maturing) face in transport vesicles.
Step 4: Conclude Option A is correct.

translations.stemText: யூகேரியோட்டிக் செல்லில் புரதங்கள் மற்றும் லிப்பிடுகளை கிளைகோபுரதங்கள் மற்றும் கிளைகோலிப்பிடுகளாக வேதியியல் மாற்றம் செய்து தொகுக்கும் முதன்மை செல் உறுப்பு எது?

stemText: During which specific substage of Prophase I in meiosis does crossing over (genetic recombination) between non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes take place under the mediation of the enzyme recombinase?

solution.explanationText:
Step 1: In Leptotene, chromosomes condense.
Step 2: In Zygotene, synapsis occurs to form bivalents and the synaptonemal complex.
Step 3: In Pachytene, non-sister chromatids cross over at recombination nodules mediated by recombinase.
Step 4: In Diplotene, chiasmata become visible as the synaptonemal complex dissolves.
Step 5: Conclude Option A is correct.
